title: Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm
html:
Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm is a free reaction available to Swarmkeeper rangers who have chosen the Flurry of Moths. It can be triggered once per turn when hitting an enemy to potentially blind it. It is the upgraded version of Flurry of Moths: Blinding Swarm unlocked at level 11 with Mighty Swarm.

Description

Use your swarm to  Blind and  Slow your target.

Properties

Details
 CON Save (Spell save DC)
 Recharge: Per turn

Condition: Blinded

 Blinded

Duration: 1 turn

 CON Save (Spell save DC)

  • Has  Disadvantage on  Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
  • Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have  Advantage.

Condition: Slowed

 Slowed

Duration: 1 turn

 CON Save (Spell save DC)

  • Affected entity's  Movement Speed is halved, and its  Armour Class and Dexterity  Saving Throws are reduced by 2.
  • The entity can't take  Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn,[See: Bugs] and can only take either an  Action or a  Bonus Action.
  • Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn.[See: Bugs]

How to learn

Classes:
  • Class level 11: Swarmkeeper

Notes

  • The  Blinded condition only lasts 1 turn and ends at the start of the enemy's turn. This means it will not affect the enemy for even a single turn.

Bugs

  • A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to targets, triggers the passives from  Boots of Stormy Clamour,  Coldbrim Hat, and  Diadem of Arcane Synergy when a target successfully rolls a saving throw against this reaction.
